title: Hydroxychloroquine in systemic lupus erythematosus
text: Hydroxychloroquine modulates innate immune activation, in part through inhibition of toll-like receptor signaling within endosomal compartments. It is recommended for nearly all patients with systemic lupus erythematosus due to its favorable effect on disease flares and long-term organ damage accrual.
